# Signpath

SignPath is a code signing service that integrates with your build system to automate the signing of your software artifacts, ensuring their authenticity and integrity.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/signpath/.

## Actions

- **List Certificates** (read-only): Retrieve the list of certificates for an organization.
- **Retrieve Signing Policy Details** (read-only): Retrieve details about signing policies for the current organization.
- **Retrieve System Info** (read-only): Retrieve signpath system information including product, api version, environment details, and ui base url.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List all projects for an organization.
